headline: IMF Approves Third Review of Argentina Program, Unlocking $900 Million
summary: The IMF board approved the third review of its agreement with Argentina, paving the way for a disbursement of approximately $900 million.
why: IMF program reviews are critical for Argentina to secure foreign reserve liquidity and maintain external sovereign debt stability.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: The $900 million disbursement reinforces central bank reserves and market credibility.

why_moved: Formal IMF approval paves the way for an immediate $900 million foreign exchange inflow.
